entries.reason: `IF VE-RESP = EIBRESP AND VE-RESP = WS-RESP` ELSE arm: LS-EIB is based on the pointer ADDRESS EIB returns, the task's own EIB storage, so VE-RESP is EIBRESP; EIBRESP is the response of the READQ TD just issued, which is also what RESP(WS-RESP) returns. Equal on every run for any queue state.
